description: Create a folder in the World Codex (omit campaign_id) or a campaign workspace (campaign_id set). Free accounts can keep up to 3 folders in total across the World Codex and campaign workspaces; paid plans have no folder limit.

campaign_id.description: Campaign UUID for a workspace folder; omit for the World Codex

display_order.description: Optional sort position among siblings (lower sorts first)

parent_collection_id.description: Optional parent folder UUID (nest inside it)
